claim: In Dutch Jaffna, colonial registration and legal codification did not create caste ex nihilo, but they made hierarchy and caste-bound obligations more legible to the state and could strengthen dominant Vellalar control over subordinate groups.
bounded_by: Both supporting works are distinct scholarly works on Dutch/Jaffna institutions but share the Cambridge publishing domain. Preserve the colonial-hardening mechanism as bounded until an independent source family corroborates it; this is not a claim that Europeans invented caste.
notes: Use as a colonial hardening/reworking mechanism, not as a claim that Europeans invented caste.
